review.summary: The patch adds a String moduleId field to SystemUserEvent, populates it from moduleDescriptor.getId() in SystemUserEventProvider at the single event construction point (thereby covering create, update new/old, and delete/deprecation lifecycles), preserves existing fields and the name semantics via SemverUtils.getName, and updates unit tests and JSON test fixtures accordingly.

findings.claim: AC1 is satisfied: moduleId is set to moduleDescriptor.getId() (full ID with version) and this is asserted in SystemUserEventProviderTest with the value 'test-module-0.0.1'; name remains the version-less name, preserving backward compatibility (requirement 4).

AC2 lifecycle coverage is addressed: the moduleId population occurs in the single provider construction site used by all lifecycles, and fixtures were updated for create (system-user.json for module2/3/4), update with both new and old values (system-user-update.json), and deprecation old value (system-user-deprecated.json). The patch alone cannot prove no other SystemUserEvent construction sites exist in unseen files, but any missed caller would fail compilation/tests under AC3.
findings.evidence: Fixture diffs add "moduleId": "folio-module2-2.1.0" / "folio-module2-2.0.0" to new/old of system-user-update.json, "folio-module3-3.0.0" to old of system-user-deprecated.json, and moduleId to the three create fixtures.
